correctness.rationale: For a finite affine plane of order q≥2, graph distances give all point pairs at 2, intersecting line pairs at 2, parallel lines at 4 and nonincidence point-line at 3. The scale-two clique complex splits U∪V with U∩V=incidence graph G, U contractible, V collapsing to the join B of q+1 discrete q-point parallel-line classes. B is a wedge of (q−1)^(q+1) q-spheres and is simply connected (q≥2), making G→B nullhomotopic. Homotopy pushout gives B∨ΣG and β1(G)=q²(q+1)−(2q²+q)+1=(q−1)²(q+1). At q=2 the q-spheres are S2 and totals become 3+1=4. Inspected verifier enumerates q2 and q3 only, not extrapolated to all q; universal argument is combinatorial/topological.
